article.title: Moloney-MacDonald scores four tries as England thump USA
article.summary: Watch highlights as England bounce back from defeats to Canada with a 55-12 win over USA in the WXV Global Series.
article.content: Watch highlights as England bounce back from defeats to Canada with a 55-12 win over USA in the WXV Global Series.
article.aiArticle:
England delivered a dominant response in the WXV Global Series on Friday, routing the United States **55-12** following a standout four-try performance by **Moloney-MacDonald**, according to **BBC Sport**. 

The comprehensive victory allowed the squad to rebound swiftly after suffering consecutive losses to Canada. Supporters looking at the broader picture can trace this momentum through our earlier coverage detailing how the [Red Roses put defeats behind them by crushing USA to extend 35-year streak](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/red-roses-put-defeats-behind-them-by-crushing-usa-to-extend-year). Friday's encounter showcased a clinical attacking display that reasserted the team's standing in international competition.

## Dominant Display Secures Bounce-Back Win

According to the report, **Moloney-MacDonald** led the charge by touching down four times against the American defense. The decisive bonus-point victory reaffirmed the team's competitive edge on the international stage after previous setbacks threatened their campaign. Observers tracking the squad's recovery can also read about how [England see off USA to return to winning ways](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/england-see-off-usa-to-return-to-winning-ways) for additional perspective on their tactical adjustments.

The WXV competition serves as a premier annual tournament designed to elevate the competitiveness of women's international rugby union by uniting top-tier global teams in a unified series. Matches of this scale dictate world rankings and test squad depth, making rapid recovery from poor form essential for teams hoping to maintain championship aspirations. 

## Broader Implications and Next Steps

Context: Strong tournament performances carry significant weight for national unions, influencing funding, fan engagement, and psychological momentum ahead of upcoming international windows. Rebuilding confidence after losses to strong rivals like Canada prevents lingering doubt from derailing a multi-year competitive cycle.

What to watch: Analysts will monitor how coaching staff manage player fatigue and squad rotation in subsequent tournament fixtures to ensure peak physical condition. Future team selections will indicate whether this winning lineup remains intact for upcoming tests.

Sources: [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/rugby-union/videos/c65yn0w2w152o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
